injuries.name: Morgan Frost
injuries.note: Frost was on the receiving end of a big hit from Ottawa's Tyler Kleven in the middle frame. Frost managed a couple of shifts after briefly going to the locker room following the hit, but he ultimately couldn't finish the game. Since there was no update on the 27-year-old's status, he can be considered day-to-day for now. Calgary will continue its five-game road trip in Pittsburgh on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Martin Pospisil
injuries.note: After leaving Saturday's 4-3 overtime loss to Chicago late in the second period with an upper-body injury, Pospisil won't play against Ottawa on Monday. It's unclear when he will be ready to return, but he could be out for a while. Pospisil has a concussion history, and the Flames may take a cautious approach with his recovery.

injuries.name: Jonathan Huberdeau
injuries.note: Huberdeau played well in his first career AHL game. The 33-year-old is wrapping up the rehab process for his hip surgery. He can spend up to two weeks with the Wranglers on this conditioning loan, but if he continues to play well, he may not need the full amount of time before he's ready for his NHL season debut.

injuries.name: Kevin Bahl
injuries.note: Bahl suffered the injury in pregame warmups before Friday's 5-3 loss to Anaheim. He will finish the 2026-27 campaign with one goal, one assist, 12 shots on net, 16 blocked shots and 22 hits in 16 appearances. The Flames placed Bahl on injured reserve before Sunday's matchup against Philadelphia and recalled Brayden Pachal from AHL Calgary.

injuries.name: Andre Burakovsky
injuries.note: Burakovsky has yet to join his teammates on the ice since getting hurt in late October, but this is a positive step in the right direction for the 31-year-old winger. In his eight appearances this year, Burakovsky has yet to register a point, recording four blocks, three hits and three shots while averaging just 11:00 of ice time, a career-low mark.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Foegele has been sidelined since late October, and he initially carried a return timetable of 3-4 weeks. While he hasn't yet entered that window, the fact that he hasn't yet resumed skating suggests that he isn't particularly close to returning to game action. A better idea of the 30-year-old's timetable to return will likely come into focus once he's cleared to return to the ice.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.
